LanguageData.LP_Troll.label: troll
LanguageData.LP_Troll.description: Once bred as melee bioweapons for harsh environments. Trolls have olive-green skin, broad jaws, pointed ears and hulking bodies; adults are about 1.5 times the size of an ordinary person, and ordinary apparel and weapons display along with the body. Trolls sustain their flesh regeneration with large amounts of food and are born with vanilla "robust digestion", not minding raw food at all; when fed, wounds heal rapidly, and blood loss, old scars and lost external parts slowly recover. Fire and acid temporarily block regeneration; a dead troll stands back up after about a day as long as the corpse hasn't been burned, hasn't rotted and still has its brain.
LanguageData.LP_Troll.descriptionShort: A tall, gluttonous green melee xenohuman; no mood penalty for raw food. Regenerates when fed, revives unless the corpse is burned; fire blocks regeneration.
